title: Fibroblast-enriched senescence-associated transcription and a distinct FAP-linked matrix state in colorectal cancer: reproducibility archive
description: Version 1.4.0 freezes the tumour-only GSE132465 analysis, independent GSE166555 direction check, signature-specificity audits, CPTAC and prognosis boundaries, patient-level confidence intervals, lowercase-panel publication figures, input hashes and independent review records supporting the AJCR v6.4 manuscript.
